This is database-recorded for the exact/core reaction; temperature, time, and yield were not returned.

entities.name: TBDMS ether
observations: The input contains a CH2-O-Si(CH3)2-C(CH3)3 protecting group, identified as a tert-butyldimethylsilyl ether.

entities.name: Selective O-desilylation
observations: The transformation cleaves the O-Si bond of the TBDMS ether and yields the corresponding CH2-OH alcohol while retaining the heteroaromatic and fluorinated scaffold.
Plausible but non-documented alternatives include TBAF in THF, aqueous mineral acid in a protic solvent, and HF-pyridine.
